media.description: The entrance of the Hotel Kaiserhof on Wilhelmplatz in 1932. On 28 March 1933 Joseph Goebbels addressed the film industry here; the next day the Ufa board resolved to dismiss its Jewish staff.

timelineEvents.title: Ufa resolves to terminate the contracts of its Jewish staff
timelineEvents.label: 29 March 1933 · Ufa board resolution
timelineEvents.shortDescription: One day after Goebbels addressed the film industry at the Hotel Kaiserhof, the Ufa board resolved to end the contracts of its Jewish staff.
timelineEvents.longDescription: On 28 March 1933 Joseph Goebbels addressed representatives of the film industry at the Hotel Kaiserhof in Berlin. The next day the board of Universum-Film AG resolved in principle that contracts with its Jewish employees were to be terminated wherever possible, each board member deciding who in his department was to go at once and who was to be removed “im Wege eines langsamen Abbaues”, through a gradual reduction. The resolution was not limited to German citizens, so it reached Kaper and Jurmann as well, and its effect on their work was visible during the production of Kind, ich freu’ mich auf Dein Kommen.
